about: Latest release of each CadenceUX FileMaker skill, and the toolchain the set was last tested with. Read by fmp-dev-orchestrator's stack check. Update on every skill release (cadenceux-skill-creator release checklist).

retired.fmp-dev-full-script: Retired 2026-10-11: clipboard XML script generation, replaced by Claris ADT.

adt.note: Claris ADT, and the FileMaker Pro build it needs, are in Claris's preview programs, so their version numbers aren't published here. The stack check reads them from your own install: ADT's version, the FileMaker Pro version ADT states it needs, and the packages ADT's project template ships.

sources.adt_updates_note: No public ADT update feed yet. The stack check also looks for an ADT entry in the Claris updates feed, so once Claris publishes ADT there (as it does for FileMaker Pro and Server) the check reports the latest ADT with no skill change. If Claris publishes a separate feed, set adt_updates_feed here.

outside_set.clockwork-inspector: Not part of the CadenceUX FileMaker set. Not superseded by ADT: keep it if you use it.
